title: Outer Banks Beach Cruiser Helicopter Tour
blurb:
Experience the stunning Outer Banks from above on the Beach Cruiser helicopter tour. This 15 minute flight offers breathtaking views of the Atlantic Ocean, Roanoke Sound, and iconic landmarks like Jennette’s Pier and Jockey’s Ridge State Park. As you soar over sandy beaches and rolling surf, look out for dolphins, sea turtles, and the historic USS Huron shipwreck. Perfect for families and anyone wanting to capture the beauty of the Outer Banks, this tour provides all window seats and live narration for an unforgettable aerial adventure.

- Duration: Approximately 15 minutes, with a total experience time of about 30 minutes
- Maximum of 3 passengers per flight
- All ages welcome, with a combined weight limit of 540 lbs per group
- Enjoy panoramic ocean views and live commentary from your pilot
